name: Of Me and My Mirror
source:
Of Me and My Mirror is a surreal, emotionally charged visual novel that explores identity, trauma, learning to let go of the past, and moving on.
You play as Phill, an emotionally withdrawn university student whose life is turned upside-down by the appearance of Prim, a chaotic and alluring stranger who seems to be another version of himself.
As the game goes on, you'll have to make choices that will ultimately affect your relationship with Prim.
translation:
《我和我的镜子》是一部超现实、充满情感的视觉小说，探讨身份、创伤、学会放下过去并继续前进。
你扮演菲尔，一个情绪孤僻的大学生，他的生活因普里姆的出现而发生了翻天覆地的变化，普里姆是一个混乱而迷人的陌生人，似乎是另一个版本的自己。
随着游戏的进行，你必须做出最终会影响你与普里姆的关系的选择。
